cases.rationale: The filed 10-K states in the issuer's first person that its June 2023 Galactic 01 flight marked the start of its commercial service; June falls in the second quarter.

basis.quote: In June 2023, we completed our first commercial spaceflight, 'Galactic 01,' which marked the start of our commercial service.

cases.rationale: Lucid reported full-year production of 8,428 vehicles, below and not greater than 10,000.

basis.quote: On a full-year basis, the Company produced 8,428 vehicles.

limitations: This is a retrospectively selected, author-curated two-case pilot and a disclosed post-hoc correction, not an independently reviewed, held-out, representative, preregistered, or deployment benchmark.
The protocol isolates admissible evidence by publication/version cutoff, but it cannot remove post-cutoff knowledge from current model parameters.
Exact-label results from two cases are descriptive smoke-test results and do not establish a general accuracy improvement.
V3 replaces the Boeing case after evaluating v1/v2 behavior, so v3 results must not be pooled with earlier pilot results as if its case selection predated those observations.
